title: Finite locally constant sheaves and finite etale schemes
statement:
In the situation of [def-galois-categories], the functor

$$
\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)\longrightarrow\mathrm{FLC}(Y),\qquad
P\longmapsto\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_Y(-,P),
$$

where $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_Y(T,P)$ is the set of
$Y$-morphisms $T\to P$, is an equivalence of categories. It is
compatible with base change and with the fibre functors, and it carries
$M$-torsors to $M$-torsors and simply transitive $M$-actions to
simply transitive ones.

proof.text: Use isFiniteLocallyConstant_yoneda_and_exists_iso for the finite etale representables. Unpack its local constancy field and convert IsFinitelyGenerated of its stalks to Finite in Type. Lift the composite inclusion followed by uliftYoneda through the full subcategory FLC.

Yoneda and full-subcategory inclusions are full and faithful. For each FLC object, convert algebraically closed stalk finiteness to IsFiniteSheaf using lem-galois-finite-stalks-comparison. Representability then gives P and an isomorphism of presheaves; lift this isomorphism through the sheaf and FLC full subcategories. This supplies EssSurj, and Functor.asEquivalence gives the desired equivalence. Its Yoneda comparison is the identity.

For the stalk comparison, lift the site point by one universe, identify uliftYoneda with shrinkYoneda, and apply shrinkYonedaCompPresheafFiberIso. Use uliftSheafFiberIso to return to the original point, then whisker the resulting natural isomorphism by the finite etale inclusion. The target functor is definitionally fiber followed by forget and uliftFunctor.

Construct the same equivalence over X. The constructed sheaf pullback has its standard adjunction to the continuous pushforward. Apply nonempty_inverseImage_representable_iso to that adjunction and whisker by the finite etale inclusion. The restricted base-change functor is definitionally FiniteEtale.pullback.

For a finite abelian torsor t choose epsilon to be the component of the given Yoneda natural isomorphism alpha at t. The underlying sheaf of toSheafTorsor is definitionally this representable. Apply alpha.hom.naturality to the finite etale endomorphism induced by t.vadd m, and evaluate at U and x. This gives exactly the displayed action equation.
